settings.title: The conference for people who actually ship .

settings.editor: Three days of hard-won lessons from the builders behind products you use every day. No fluff, no keynotes, no sales pitches.

ShipCon is a three-day, single-track conference with no sponsored talks and no product demos on stage. Every speaker is someone who has shipped real products at scale and is willing to share what actually worked — and what didn't.
Founders, engineers, and designers behind products that millions use.
A preview of the opening day. Full schedule revealed next month.
Coffee, pastries, and a lot of name tags. Meet your fellow attendees before the real work begins.

settings.title: Opening keynote: What we broke this year

settings.editor: An honest retrospective from four founders about the mistakes that almost killed their companies — and how they recovered.
How small teams decide what to build, what to cut, and when to stop polishing.
Long lunch. No schedule. Meet the people you came to meet.
Four parallel 90-minute workshops on scaling, design systems, observability, and hiring.
We release tickets in three batches. Join the list to hear about each one first.
